name: What types of surfaces can waterproof coatings be applied to?

mainEntity.name: What types of surfaces can waterproof coatings be applied to?

acceptedAnswer.text: Waterproof coatings can be applied to a variety of surfaces, including concrete, stucco, wood, metal, and existing roofing membranes. Common application areas include flat and low-slope roofs, basements, exterior walls, balconies, and wet rooms like bathrooms. The specific type of coating chosen depends on the substrate material, its exposure to weather, and the desired level of protection and durability. Proper surface preparation is essential for effective adhesion and performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Waterproof coatings can be applied to concrete, stucco, wood, metal, and roofs. Common areas include basements, exterior walls, and balconies.
